blocks.note: Distinguish additive contrast with pero from correction after negation with sino or sino que, and keep conditional si no separate.
Apply the sound-conditioned e and u forms of y and o while preserving ni and the intended coordination.
Choose que, de que, or interrogative qué from the governing construction instead of inserting or dropping de mechanically.
Separate interrogative por qué, causal porque, and the noun el porqué by syntactic role and stress.
Frame a concession with aunque or related expressions, reserving y eso que for an established fact after the main statement.
Replace a neutral si condition only where the chosen conditional expression and its required subjunctive preserve the intended force.
Recast a cause, warning, or alternative as an intended outcome with para que plus the subjunctive.
Choose a time conjunction once, then match the verb mood to habitual or completed reference versus an anticipated event.
